scenes.text: Predict and test an event using repeated fair trials. Record all results and compare the observed frequencies.
Which is more likely: red (4) or blue (6) bottle tops? The answer is blue. Compare the counts; 4 red versus 6 blue.
A bag at a school fair has 6 red and 5 blue bottle tops. Which colour is more likely on one random draw? Pause to choose and explain.
